title: Myth: b = a makes a copy
why_it_matters: Shared arrays cause bugs where changing one list alters another.
explanation: Fact: assigning an array to another variable doesn't copy it, both names point to the same array. Spread, [...a], builds a new array with the same items. It's the basic move for changing data without damaging the original.
try_it: Quiz: what does c hold if you push 4 into a after copying? Run it.
